dialogues.speaker: Xugney
dialogues.text: That's right! It's been a while since I've returned to Fontaine, so I'm trying to see what's new.

dialogues.speaker: Xugney
dialogues.text: Upon sailing to other nations, I found that their peoples quite admire our advanced machine industry — I must confess that I've grown quite proud of it myself.

dialogues.speaker: Xugney
dialogues.text: But the way I see it, these clockwork devices don't quite live up to the image they have in mind...
